prompt: Write a thorough test file test/slugify.test.mjs (node:test + node:assert) for `slugify` in src/slugify.js. Read the implementation and pin down its exact behaviour: lower-casing, accent removal, how runs of separators and punctuation collapse, trimming of leading/trailing dashes, and the maxLength option and its default (including not ending on a dash after truncation). The tests must pass on the current implementation. Do not change src/. Run `node --test` (it finds test/*.test.mjs; on Node 24 `node --test test/` fails because a directory argument is not accepted).
